pages.title: The camp answers
pages.text:
Tribal Weave is the workshop beside the nine Strands. Rhythm, landscape and reusable Echo catalysts make Pulse.\
Open the **Spirit Codex** for every generator, station, relay, Kiln, Voice Ring and rite. Sneak-use it on a silent machine. This book does not copy those manuals.

pages.title: What the pack needs
pages.text:
**Goal:** a Resonator that can feed Spark, then the later workshops the Spirit Codex diagrams.\
You need the **Spirit Codex** and a working Pulse Resonator from Start here.\
1\. Finish **Make the first Echo Shard** and **Start automatic power** in Start here.\
2\. Keep the Spirit Codex on your hotbar while you run Tribal Weave.

pages.title: Continue
pages.text: 3\. Slot faces, Shatter-on-Kiln, relays, compass landings and the sixth Loom voice live in that book, not here.

pages.title: Check
pages.text: **Check:** sneak-use the Spirit Codex on the Resonator. Stored Pulse should rise with two different voices and a catalyst seated.
